title: nazar's headibles
description: adds edible player heads to the game. they look like food and eat like food and act like food. but because they are heads, they can be placed like furniture to make in-game decoration food.
body: adds new food to minecraft. food that didn't exist before. you can eat it. it's edible. that makes it food. it's food for you. i made it. more food that should have existed before, but didn't. now it does.
